setup.title: Settings
setup.intro: Set up your organization, its offices, units of measure and document numbering.

validation.officeCode: Use 2–10 capital letters or digits, e.g. MAD.
validation.unitCode: Use up to 20 capital letters, digits, - or _.

organization.title: Organization
organization.intro: Names, logo, contact details and financial settings used on every document.
organization.baseCurrencyHint: Exchange rates are entered against this currency.
organization.baseCurrencyLocked: Fixed because purchase requisitions have already been submitted.
organization.doaReferenceCurrencyHint: Approval amount bands are expressed in this currency.
organization.timezoneHint: Decides the date and year of submissions, e.g. Africa/Khartoum.
organization.maxBackdateDaysHint: How many days before submission a requisition date may be (0–365).
organization.logoHint: PNG, JPEG, WEBP or SVG, up to 2 MB. Earlier logos stay on documents already printed.
organization.logoInvalid: Choose a PNG, JPEG, WEBP or SVG image of at most 2 MB.

onboarding.title: Create your organization
onboarding.intro: You will be its Organization Admin. Default units, roles, PR numbering and approval steps are added for you and can be changed later.
onboarding.alreadyMember: You already belong to an organization.
onboarding.adminHint: Optional. Your email address is used when left empty.

offices.title: Offices
offices.intro: Offices and locations. The office code is part of every PR number.
offices.dialogIntro: Enter the office's names in both languages and a short code.
offices.codeHint: 2–10 capital letters or digits, e.g. MAD. It appears in PR numbers.
offices.codeLocked: The code cannot change because purchase requisitions already use it in their numbers.
offices.name: Name
offices.empty: No offices yet. Add the first one.

units.title: Units of measure
units.intro: Units used on requisition lines. Deactivate a unit instead of deleting it.

numbering.title: Document numbering
numbering.intro: Format of purchase requisition numbers. Sequences restart every year for each office.
numbering.paddingHint: The sequence is padded with zeros to this many digits (1–10).
numbering.futureOnly: Changes apply only to numbers assigned from now on. Existing numbers never change.

common.noOrganization: You are not a member of any organization yet. Ask your organization's administrator for an invitation.
common.homeIntro: Choose an item from the menu to get started.
common.invalidDate: Enter a valid date as DD/MM/YYYY

auth.magicLinkSent: We sent a sign-in link to your email.
auth.acceptInviteIntro: Choose a password for your account to finish joining.
auth.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least 8 characters.
auth.inviteLinkInvalid: The invitation link is invalid or has expired. Ask for a new invitation.

errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Some fields are invalid. Check the highlighted fields.
errors.UNAUTHORIZED: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.SEGREGATION_OF_DUTIES: You cannot approve a requisition you created or sign more than one of its steps.
errors.NOT_FOUND: The requested item was not found.
errors.VERSION_CONFLICT: Someone else changed this record. Reload and try again.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: This request was already sent with different data.
errors.INVALID_STATE: This action is not allowed in the requisition's current status.
errors.OFFICE_CODE_IN_USE: The office code cannot change because purchase requisitions use it.
errors.EXCHANGE_RATE_IN_USE: This rate is used by a purchase requisition. Enter a corrected rate instead of editing it.
errors.BUDGET_EXCEEDED: The requested amount exceeds the available balance of the budget line.
errors.BUDGET_BELOW_USAGE: The budget cannot be reduced below what is reserved, committed and spent.
errors.GRANT_NOT_ACTIVE: The grant is not active (suspended or closed).
errors.GRANT_PERIOD_MISMATCH: The requisition date is outside the grant period.
errors.PR_DATE_OUT_OF_RANGE: The requisition date is outside the allowed range.
errors.GRANT_OFFICE_MISMATCH: The requesting office is not one of the grant's offices.
errors.EXCHANGE_RATE_MISSING: No exchange rate is recorded for one of the currencies on this date.
errors.PR_EMPTY: Add at least one line with a total greater than zero.
errors.REQUIRED_BY_BEFORE_PR_DATE: The required-by date cannot be before the requisition date.
errors.NO_ELIGIBLE_APPROVER: No eligible user exists for one of the approval steps.
errors.APPROVAL_RULE_INVALID: The approval rule is not valid.
errors.IMPORT_INVALID_ROWS: There are no valid rows to import.
errors.PR_LINE_GRANT_MISMATCH: The budget line or activity does not belong to the requisition's grant.
errors.EXCHANGE_RATE_BASE_CURRENCY: The base currency does not need an exchange rate.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests in a short time. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Could not reach the server. Check your internet connection.
